name: sked
description: SKED (Socratic Knowledge Elicitation & Documentation): turns a human expert's knowledge into a formal LaTeX/PDF technical document through a Socratic dialogue with a tracked knowledge ledger, a measurable convergence criterion, human-confirmed consensus K*, an agreed structure, Cyrillic-ready XeLaTeX builds in IEEE, DSTU or APA style, and a Q(R) quality gate with an independent coherence review.
